previous_versions.body: If the user directly uploads a symlink that links to /etc/passwd the user's  passwd file would be uploaded to the server. But if the app has a function to untar or unzip (for example, a Ruby app), and then the user is able to see the content of the uploaded zip or tar file, then the user will be able to see the server's passwd file. I believe on of the mitigations is to remove any symlinks when the app starts to extract a compressed file.
